operator_correction.cause: Both database dump files were accidentally omitted from the first encrypted payload. Independent restore caught the missing archive before database restoration.
operator_correction.fix: A separately authenticated encrypted supplement contains both hash-verified database dumps from the same frozen snapshot. Both parts are required and included in the final checked ZIP. No live resnapshot or source service interruption.

credential_handling: Encrypted source export only. Recovery key configuration decrypted solely in private temporary local files and tested using a synthetic canary. No existing provider token decrypted or production login session used. Recipient private key remains in a mode-0600 local file, outside the encrypted ZIP and Git.
vm_runtime_boundary: Source production services, databases and configuration were unchanged; only private encrypted export artifacts were created on VM. The validation live_vm_modified=false field concerns production runtime, not private backup-file creation.
remaining: Real browser/OAuth login against a newly provisioned recovered host.
